songs.title: Nebijok
songs.description: Mary's yes is a genuine choice made before understanding — faith precedes comprehension.

pericopes.title: Marijos giesmė

songs.title: Pamatė mane
songs.description: The Magnificat is not a hymn recited — it is the shock of someone invisible who was finally seen.

pericopes.title: Zacharijo pranašystė

songs.title: Aušra
songs.description: Zechariah's nine months of forced silence became a gestation of its own — his first word back is his son.

pericopes.imageAlt: Peizažas prieš aušrą su sausa žole, siluetuojančia prieš silpną šiltą švytėjimą horizonte po tamsiu dangumi

pericopes.title: Augimas dykumoje
